verdict.rationale: The Titan Security Key is a physical FIDO/U2F authenticator. An agent-facing MCP server is a category error for a hardware sign-in token, and nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any software, API, or MCP surface that would make the axis apply. The runtime probe confirms Titan has no vendor CLI, SDK, API, or MCP surface, and fleet management belongs to the separate Workspace Admin console.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
